Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryBlendOptimizationPlan

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryBlendOptimizationPlan
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryBlendOptimizationPlan extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, label-addressable plan for one qualified refinery blend optimization.

This class composes an existing RefineryLinearBlendOptimizer.Result, its scaled RefineryBlendBatch, and a RefineryBlendSourceLedger. It adds source-level cost receipts and closure checks without re-solving the optimization or changing any qualified property calculation.

  • Method Details

    • fromOptimization

      public static RefineryBlendOptimizationPlan fromOptimization(String[] sourceIdentifiers, double totalMassKg, double[] sourceSpecificGravities, double[] sourceCostsPerMass, RefineryLinearBlendOptimizer.Result optimization)
      Compose one optimized recipe, scaled batch, labeled source ledger, and cost ledger.
      Parameters:
      sourceIdentifiers - unique nonblank identifiers in optimization source order
      totalMassKg - requested positive batch mass in kg
      sourceSpecificGravities - source specific gravities on the 60 degrees Fahrenheit basis
      sourceCostsPerMass - source costs in the optimizer's common currency/mass basis
      optimization - qualified refinery linear-blend result
      Returns:
      immutable optimized blend plan
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if optimization is null
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid, mismatched, or cost-inconsistent inputs
      IllegalStateException - if copied receipts do not close to the qualified batch
